title: FAO Internship Programme (Headquarters, Rome)
description: A paid internship at the headquarters of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) in Rome, Italy, running 3 to 11 months depending on the assignment. Interns support FAO's work on food security, nutrition, and sustainable agriculture, fisheries, and forestry. Unsponsored interns (those without university or external funding) receive a monthly stipend of USD 700, plus medical coverage for the internship's duration; FAO does not cover travel costs, so interns arrange and pay for their own trip to Rome. Applicants must be 21-30 years old at the internship's start, either currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD programme (at a university listed in the World Higher Education Database) or a recent graduate within 2 years, and a citizen of an FAO member country -- effectively open worldwide, since FAO has nearly 200 members. Application deadline: 25 August 2026.
org: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
visaNote: This is a paid internship, not standard employment; interns are responsible for their own visa/residence-permit arrangements to work in Italy for the internship's duration.
